suggestion.guidance: Name what makes the hedges black: shadow, rain or night.

payload.body: Consider ending on a sound: the gutters overflowing into the lane.

payload.summary: Atmospheric; a few verbs could work harder.

content.text: The rain fell on the weathered roof. She lingerd by the window. Her tea had gone cold. Nothing outside. The lane was deserted and the hedges were dark with rain. Somewhere a dog barked. The gutters were overflowing into the lane.
